2607.12885.title: LLM Judges Can Be Too Generous When There Is No Reference Answer
2607.12885.paper_summary: LLM judges are increasingly being used to evaluate open-ended model responses, often in no-reference settings where a ground-truth answer is unavailable. However, can they reliably assess in such evaluation setups? We explore this question in this paper through a two stage pipeline with a) calibration experiments that assess the judge model's knowledge of the task it is evaluating, and b) sensitivity experiments that assess how the judge model's performance is impacted by the presence and positioning of the reference answer in the prompt. Across experiments covering three languages, we show that the judge models we evaluated tend to over-credit incorrect answers in the absence of a reference answer, and adding reference answer information to the prompt flips the judge model's correct/incorrect decisions by as much as 85% in some experimental settings. Comparison with a subset of human annotations shows that these reference-driven changes generally align with human judgments. Our results emphasize the need for calibrating the LLM judges with a sample with reference-aware evaluation before using them in reference-free setups reliably, and our methodology provides a blueprint for researchers and practitioners in doing such calibration of LLM judges for other tasks.
2607.12885.paper_summary_zh: LLM 評判模型越來越多地被用來評估開放式模型的回應，通常是在沒有參考的情況下進行評估，這時候無法獲得真實答案。<lb/>然而，在這樣的評估設置中，它們能否可靠地進行評估？<lb/>我們在本文中通過兩階段的流程探討了這個問題，a) 校準實驗評估評判模型對其正在評估的任務的知識，b) 敏感性實驗評估評判模型的表現如何受到提示中參考答案的存在和位置的影響。<lb/>在涵蓋三種語言的實驗中，我們顯示出所評估的評判模型在缺乏參考答案的情況下，往往會過度肯定不正確的答案，並且在某些實驗設置中，將參考答案信息添加到提示中會使評判模型的正確/不正確決策翻轉多達 85%。<lb/>與一部分人類標註的比較顯示，這些基於參考的變化通常與人類判斷一致。<lb/>我們的結果強調了在可靠地使用 LLM 評判模型於無參考設置之前，需要用參考意識評估的樣本來進行校準，並且我們的方法論為研究人員和實踐者提供了進行 LLM 評判模型校準的藍圖，以應用於其他任務。
